_variation_rule.why: An entry is a topic, not a card. The same date must not produce the same sentence year after year â€” five angles means the same reader sees a fresh take for five years. Record which angle ran in the data bank so next year picks another.
_variation_rule.growth: Research adds angles. When a pull turns up something new about a recurring topic, append it here rather than losing it â€” that is how the list gets richer instead of staler.
_variation_rule.status: Angles written for homestead-deadline and tax-bills-mailed as worked examples. Every other entry still needs its five.
